column1: # Measured placement oracle for price.zig and context_cost.zig `gpuWins` (the "price
# picks the measured winner" test in context_cost.zig).
# cpu_s, cuda_s: wall seconds of one process, run the way the corpus runs it
# (`--backend X --format=binary -b -r out deck`), RTX 4060 Laptop (sm_89, persistence
# off) and i9-14900HX, ReleaseSafe espice built from ea150655 (scratchpad rs-tip),
# 2026-11-02. Medians of 3 except ltra_tran_long_run_past_8192 and
# cpl_tran_history_past_2048 on cuda (one run each: 1973 s and 317 s, the second with
# --timing-in-depth). Every cuda run had every batch resident: that binary has no host
# routing, so `host` batches lost the device run by the measured ratio.
# evals: Newton evals of the run (--timing-in-depth, ESPICE_GPU_STATS census).
# rows: count:host_us:held_bytes per GPU-eligible batch. host_us from the `auto` probe
# (ESPICE_GPU_STATS `cpu=`, split by instance count; R and V below the probe's 1 us
# print are 0.1). held_bytes of the history lines from their models/*.va caps.
# fixed_us: ESPICE_GPU_STATS `gpu=` minus 0.12 of `cpu=` (that binary's kernel term), or
# 40 where the planes are a few cells. init_us: a cold driver (each deck is a process).
# host: batches the explicit-device placement keeps on the host (price.staysOnHost).
# known: `-`, or the cause of a deck the price puts on the wrong side (it must fail).
